name: scale-slider
blurb: Carousel where adjacent slides scale down, centering the active slide.
description: Embla-carousel-based component displaying slides that scale smaller when not in focus. Includes prev/next buttons and dot navigation. Pre-built with colored demo slides.
use_when: Highlighting a primary slide among others in a compact, visually-distinct carousel.
avoid_when: Touch navigation—scaling transitions can be jarring on swipe-based devices.
a11y: Arrow buttons for navigation; dot buttons for direct slide access. No ARIA labels. No prefers-reduced-motion support.
